p: What is the reason for the Rabbis’
take her to him to be his wife and consummate the levirate marriage [veyibbema]”
the first levirate bond is still upon her. … But … that which we learn … he took … in marriage … then her

the first levirate bond is still upon her. Even after she is taken as a wife by the second brother, her earlier status as wife of her late first husband is still in effect. The Gemara challenges this: But what about that which we learn in a mishna (38a): If he took his yevama in marriage as his wife, then her
that of his wife in every sense;
